relationships.subject: 5-fluorouracil
relationships.evidence_quote: The 5-FU group showed a significant increase in the mRNA expression levels of interleukin (IL)-6 (4.74 ± 2.47-fold), IL-8 (4.47 ± 2.76-fold), MMP-2 (3.52 ± 0.77-fold), and MMP-9 (8.07 ± 3.65-fold) compared with the control group.

relationships.subject: β-cryptoxanthin
relationships.evidence_quote: However, β-cry down-regulated the expression of IL-8 and MMP-9 and IL-8 and ROS production induced by 5-FU treatment in oral mucosa-derived keratinocytes.

key_findings: β-cryptoxanthin suppressed 5-FU-induced IL-8 and MMP-9 expression in oral keratinocytes
